text:
mike: CI red on macos-latest after I ran `poetry lock` while landing infra-deps. Failing wheel build for httptools (pulled from git). Quick look at the log:
```
  ERROR: Could not build wheels for httptools, which is required to install pyproject.toml-based projects
  [build_ext] error: command 'x86_64-apple-darwinclang' failed with exit code 1
```
Anyone seen this before?

lina: can you paste the top ~20 lines of the build log (or link to the job)?

mike: job link: https://ci.example.com/teams/redwood/runs/9423 (private). Top lines:
```
  Collecting httptools==git+https://github.com/MagicStack/httptools@d4e5f#egg=httptools
  Preparing metadata (pyproject.toml) ... done
  Building wheel for httptools (pyproject.toml) ... error
  ERROR: Failed building wheel for httptools
```

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @haris: `/rerun 1934567890`

haris: running a rerun now to rule out flake.

ci-bot: Rerun finished — still failing on macos-latest. linux jobs green.

sara: sounds like a mac wheel build issue because it's coming from a git ref (no prebuilt wheel). Could be a C-extension or mac toolchain mismatch. We've had similar with uvloop/httptools before.

lina: can we temporarily pin httptools to a released wheel-compatible version (e.g., ==0.5.0) via pyproject constraints to unblock CI? Or vendor the relevant code.

mike: bisect would tell us which lock change introduced the git ref. I'm short on cycles but can try a quick check.

haris: I can run a deps bisect using our script: `git bisect start -- --scripts/ci/bisect-deps.sh` (quick heads-up: script iterates lockfile states and runs test subset). Will run now.

haris: bisect result: commit abc1234 from last poetry lock regen swapped httptools 0.5.0 -> git+https://github.com/MagicStack/httptools@d4e5f. It looks like websockets/uvloop started depending on that ref.

sara: ok that's consistent. Short-term fixes: 1) revert that lock entry (fast), 2) add explicit constraint `httptools = "==0.5.0"` in pyproject to force the wheel, or 3) skip macos test if we can't rebuild. I prefer revert + constraint so CI is green and we file a follow-up to coordinate with package maintainer.

lina: I'll prepare a minimal patch: add constraint + regen lock, include comment linking this thread. Can someone validate on mac runner before merge?

mike: testing locally on mac VM with patch applied. Running `tox -e py39-macos` — builds wheels and tests proceed. I'll push a quick PR with the revert + comment.

mike: PR #4782 opened: revert lock entry for httptools + explicit constraint. @lina @sara PTAL. :thumbsup:

sara: looks good, will approve once CI passes. Also filing an issue to ask upstream to publish wheels for the commit or create a release.

lina: adding note to changelog and a follow-up task to monitor downstream transitive pins.

mike: thanks all. If CI still flakes after merge, I'll follow up with a more targeted bisect of the mac toolchain.
